skills.name: edge-agent-runtime-setup
skills.description: Set up and inspect EdgeAgent, a portable tool-using LLM agent, with a llama.cpp CPU backend or a Qualcomm AI Runtime (QAIRT) Genie NPU backend, on a Snapdragon X Elite PC or a Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ-8275 (IQ8) or Dragonwing IQ-9075 (IQ9) board, and preview its MCP client configuration before anything is written.
useCases: Set up EdgeAgent with a local llama.cpp server
Point EdgeAgent at the Genie NPU backend on my Snapdragon X Elite PC
Run the EdgeAgent doctor check and explain every failure
Preview the MCP client configuration for the stdio-ssh transport without installing it
Check whether EdgeAgent can reach its model server on my IQ8
What do I need installed to run EdgeAgent on an IQ9 board?
Which EdgeAgent transport fits my setup: stdio-local, stdio-ssh or sse-http?
